description: Allow life to evolve , you don’t have to control everything #control #lettingo #movingon
transcript: One of the greatest lessons that I've learned is to allow things to just be. Things are not as complex as we make them. Far too often are we internalizing things and making things personal. And they're things that are just, they're tiny, they're small. They are things that need to just evolve. They are things that need to just sit and work themselves out. The more that I've allowed myself to live in a space of allowing things to be, I find comfort, I find peace, I find flexibility, and I find myself able to make space for other things. I am not sitting in my head thinking about situations that I don't have control over. The more that I sit still and allow things to be, I grow and I move forward.
